description: An Rsbuild plugin for building Vanilla Lynx applications with Element PAPI.

members.name: bundleFilename
members.remarks:
When omitted under Rspeedy, `output.filename.bundle` is used.
The default outside Rspeedy is `[name].[platform].bundle`.

members.name: engineVersion
members.summary: The minimum Lynx Engine version required by the emitted bundle.

members.name: entries
members.remarks:
When omitted, every Rsbuild `source.entry` is treated as a main-thread
entry and optional sibling `background.ts` and `style.css` files are
discovered by convention.

exports.name: TemplateHooks
exports.summary:
To allow other plugins to alter the Template, this plugin executes
[tapable](https://github.com/webpack/tapable) hooks.

members.name: afterEmit
members.summary: Called after the template is emitted.

members.name: asyncChunkName
members.summary: Get the real name of an async chunk. The files with the same `asyncChunkName` will be placed in the same template.

members.name: beforeEmit
members.type: AsyncSeriesWaterfallHook<{ chunkGroups: ChunkGroup[]; cssChunks: Asset[]; cssDiagnostics?: string; debugInfo: string; finalEncodeOptions: EncodeOptions; mainThreadAssets: Asset[]; outputName: string; template: Buffer }>
members.summary: Called before the template is emitted. Can be used to modify the template.

members.name: beforeEncode
members.type: AsyncSeriesWaterfallHook<{ chunkGroups: ChunkGroup[]; encodeData: EncodeRawData; filenameTemplate: string; intermediate: string; intermediateAssets: string[] }>
members.summary: Called before the encode process. Can be used to modify the encode options.

members.name: encode
members.type: AsyncSeriesBailHook<{ encodeOptions: EncodeOptions; intermediate?: string }, { buffer: Buffer; cssDiagnostics?: string; debugInfo: string }>

exports.name: VanillaBundleFilenameContext
exports.summary: Context passed to a Vanilla Lynx bundle filename function.

members.name: lazyBundle
members.summary: Vanilla Lynx currently emits only the main card bundle.

exports.name: VanillaLynxEntry
exports.summary: The two thread source files of a logical Vanilla Lynx entry.

members.name: background
members.summary: Source executed in the background JavaScript thread.
members.remarks:
When omitted, a sibling `background.ts` is used when it exists. Set this
to `false` to explicitly create a main-thread-only bundle.

members.name: css
members.summary: CSS source encoded into the Lynx template.
members.remarks:
When omitted, a sibling `style.css` is used when it exists. Set this to
`false` to disable the convention.

members.name: mainThread
members.summary: Module request executed on the Lynx main thread with Element PAPI globals.
members.remarks:
The request is resolved by Rspeedy or Rsbuild. When it names an existing
local file, optional sibling `background.ts` and `style.css` files are
discovered by convention.

exports.name: VanillaBundleFilename
exports.summary: The final Vanilla Lynx bundle filename.

exports.name: LAYERS
exports.summary: Rspack layers used by Vanilla Lynx entries.

exports.name: pluginVanillaLynx

signatures.summary:
Create the Vanilla Lynx DSL integration for Rsbuild or Rspeedy.

A logical entry can explicitly declare its main-thread and background-thread
sources. As a shorthand, an Rsbuild entry is treated as the main-thread
source and optional sibling `background.ts` and `style.css` files are
discovered by convention.
